text_block_list.text:
At last, the senior summer camp has
come to an
end, and the fall showdown
is fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, we don't got nothin' to worry
about now,
Boss. We made massive gains
this summer.

academy.

up to do!
